model_note: Domain validity = real-world subject scope, not topic count. Pillars = operating-mode verbs, apply across every topic.

domains.label: Society & Networks
domains.desc: Collective human systems — how people organise, govern, move, and shape the world together.

domains.label: Places
domains.desc: The physical spaces shaping consciousness — retreat centers, sacred sites, monasteries, coworking communities, and intentional homes. Where the network meets the ground.

domains.label: Business
domains.desc: How enterprises are built, run, and scaled — regenerative models, social enterprise, and the organisations creating real-world impact.

domains.label: Money
domains.desc: Capital, finance, and the new monetary systems — from conscious capital and impact investing to crypto, DeFi, and the sovereign individual.

domains.label: Energy
domains.desc: The forces and resources that power existence — from solar and wind to the subtle energies that move through all living systems.

domains.label: Lifestyle
domains.desc: Conscious ways of living — the daily choices, rhythms, and practices that shape a life of intention.

domains.label: Well-being
domains.desc: Healing and wholeness — the full spectrum of human health across body, mind, and spirit.

domains.label: Food & Agriculture
domains.desc: Growing, sharing and consuming nourishment — the ancient and future relationship between humans and the land.

domains.label: Sciences
domains.desc: Empirical exploration of reality — the disciplines that probe the deep structure of life, matter, and mind.

domains.label: Nature & Cosmos
domains.desc: The living systems of existence — from ecosystems and oceans to stars, cycles, and the geometry beneath it all.

domains.label: Consciousness
domains.desc: The architecture of reality — what is there before what appears. Consciousness, dimensions, sacred law, and the invisible structures that underpin the visible world.

domains.label: Arts & Culture
domains.desc: Expression of the human spirit — music, image, story, and movement as the languages that reach where words cannot.

domains.label: Communication
domains.desc: How humans connect and express meaning — from language and dialogue to journalism and broadcast.

domains.label: Technology
domains.desc: Tools shaping the future — the technologies being built now that will define how humanity lives and works.

domains.label: Creation
domains.desc: Building what has never existed — design, systems, emergence, and the act of bringing new things into the world.

domains.label: Play & Recreation
domains.desc: Joy, games, sports and leisure — the parts of life that remind us existence is not just work.

domains.label: Curation
domains.desc: Choosing well, on every scale — from a single book pick to the full editorial line of the network. The discipline that turns information into meaning.

domains.label: Commerce
domains.desc: Exchanging value openly — storefronts, memberships, referrals, affiliates, tipping, marketplaces. The infrastructure that lets the work, the goods, and the access reach the people who want them.

pillars.label: Settle
pillars.desc: The sovereign community — physical and digital spaces where a new kind of society takes root, governed by shared values rather than geography.

pillars.label: Fund
pillars.desc: Capital allocation — directing resources toward the builders, researchers, and creators working at the frontier of conscious civilisation.

pillars.label: Educate
pillars.desc: Transmitting what's known — curating the best teachers, courses, and wisdom traditions so knowledge flows to those who need it.

pillars.label: Research
pillars.desc: Exploring what isn't known yet — mapping the edges of science, philosophy, and consciousness where the next discoveries live.

pillars.label: Broadcast
pillars.desc: Spreading the signal — amplifying the voices, stories, and art that shift perception and move culture toward something more alive.

pillars.label: Build
pillars.desc: Creating products, tools, and experiences — the hands-on arm of the network, turning ideas into things people can actually use.

pillars.label: Curate
pillars.desc: Picking with care — sifting the world's signal from its noise so what reaches FRQNCY is honest, alive, and worth attention.

pillars.label: Sell
pillars.desc: Exchanging value — letting the work, goods, and access that emerge from FRQNCY meet the people who want them, fairly and openly.
